sections.heading: OpenAI Astra Introduction
paragraphs: OpenAI has announced its 'next major model', Astra, by releasing ten previously unsolved math solutions, according to The Decoder. This demonstrates the model's advanced capabilities in mathematics and theoretical computer science.

sections.heading: Details on Astra
paragraphs: Softonic reports that Astra is a multi-agent AI designed for longer work, indicating its potential for handling complex, extended tasks.

sections.heading: Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
paragraphs: OpenAI itself has detailed ten advances in the fields of mathematics and theoretical computer science, highlighting Astra's impact on these areas.
